conclusion: Preliminary single-seed result (seed 7, mse only): OLS linear model shows lower test MSE (10.155670419036328) than the matched training-mean baseline (23.951894598705938) under 10% test-label outliers of magnitude 10 with clean training data. This is a preliminary report only; no general scientific value is claimed.
limitations: Only seed 7 and only the mse metric were executed; seeds 19 and 31 and mae/median_absolute_error were not run.
Single-seed result cannot establish stability or generality.
No significance testing or confidence intervals were computed.
Results are specific to this synthetic configuration (10% test-label outliers, magnitude 10, clean training data) and do not imply broader scientific value.
